title: Jailbreak Transferability Matrix Builder: An Open Tool for Measuring Cross-Model Attack Transfer Rates

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Useful community infrastructure but primarily replicates and packages an existing finding rather than generating new safety insight. The tool itself is the contribution, not a new safety understanding.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires running multiple open-weight models on GPU, computing embedding similarities, and building a reusable Python tool. Single-GPU constraint limits number of models testable. Beginner students would struggle with model loading, inference pipelines, and tooling quality.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Running jailbreak prompts against multiple models, computing embeddings, building a reusable tool, and validating against published results is ambitious. Model inference time alone for multiple models on single GPU could consume most of the 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
